required_scalar_normal_contract.capture: Retain actual incoming A through the ordinary parent; do not substitute a projected host/owner.
required_scalar_normal_contract.parent: Invoke genuine accepted 7379A0 with the same actual A, its actual already live rows, allocation and context.
required_scalar_normal_contract.selector: After successful parent return read the actual argument byte and test bit0. Physical selector is entryESP+4 after saved ESI and normal child RET0. Upper byte bits and higher argument bytes are not locally consumed. No cached early Boolean receives Native equivalence credit.
required_scalar_normal_contract.outer_free: If bit0 set call explicitly supplied genuine BF65AC service with captured A. If clear skip that whole free sequence. Do not free CURRENT row data again or substitute BF6989.
required_scalar_normal_contract.return: Return captured address value A, including after selected outer free, without dereferencing it. This is a static schedule, not live ownership.
required_scalar_normal_contract.failure: Parent must return before selector/free/return are reached. Its qualified C++ cleanup remains inherited. Scalar body adds no local catch, compensation, reset, refcount, null guard or extra retirement. No safe-cleanup or rollback promise.

required_free_domains.allocation_family: For the existing host service, A must be start of a compatible still-live allocation from the same actual host malloc/free family. BF681B and BF65AC service scope is host CRT; Original static CRT heap/exception identity is excluded.
required_free_domains.actual_objects: Raw singleton_lifetime_allocate bytes are uninitialized; they do not create actual Application field/row object lifetimes, actual cell/provider bindings or ownership.
required_free_domains.selection: A borrowed/stack object may satisfy ordinary parent domains but cannot satisfy selected malloc-family outer free. The retained scalar audit positively describes the startup Application as stack storage; it does not establish a new actual scalar caller flag.
required_free_domains.lifetime: Actual receiver/rows/cells/managers/sections/providers remain valid through normal or C++ cleanup parent. On selected outer free, actual allocation/provider validity is required until free returns. No access to outer/rows is admitted afterward.
required_free_domains.aliases_quiescence: Parent can leave data field dangling if its provider does not mutate it. The selected outer free can invalidate A/rows. Alias retirement/quiescence and lifetime acquisition remain external, unproved obligations.
